rewards: Access to puppies, which can be grown into dogs

st.t: Talk to Talia at the dog shelter south-west of the Edgeville Monastery.
Talk to Gertrude in her house west of Varrock, just south of the Cooks' Guild.
Interact with the stray dog barking at a guard, just south of the western Varrock bank.
Follow the stray dog to the house just west of Thessalia's Fine Clothes. If she isn't there, return to the guard just south of the western Varrock bank.
Inspect the chewed box, the torn newspaper and the rough bedding in the dog's den. Finish the dialogue after each inspection.
Interact with the stray dog again to have her pick up the puppies' scent.
Follow the stray dog from the den until a cutscene triggers north of the Cooks' Guild.
Interact with the stray dog to watch the cutscene.
Talk to the stray dog. Dismiss any pet you have out first.
Talk to Picklenose south-west of the Cooks' Guild with the stray dog following you.
Use the grain on the fur to make a stuffed dog.
Talk to Picklenose again to trade the stuffed dog for the puppy.
Pick up the stray puppy south-west of the cook's guild.
Talk to the stray dog south-west of the cook's guild to see if she can sniff out the last puppy.
Interact with the stray dog and follow her until a cutscene triggers by the gap in the wall north of the Cooks' Guild.
Kill both outlaws (level 22 and level 23), then watch the cutscene.
Talk to the stray dog north-west of the cook's guild.
With the three puppies in your inventory, talk to the stray dog in the den west of the Varrock apothecary.
With the three puppies in your inventory, talk to Talia at the dog shelter south-west of the Edgeville Monastery.
